issue: evidence window 2026-09-17T12:11:56Z to 2026-09-17T13:03:20Z. Analyzed 6 comparable successful docs.yml runs from the latest 20 completed runs in the last 14 days (1 push, 3 schedule, 2 workflow_run), while disclosing skipped, cancelled, and action_required workflow_run outliers. Parent workflow median duration was 99.5s (p90 123.5s), build median 63.5s (p90 69.5s), deploy-job median 27.5s (p90 46.5s), and queue median 0s (p90 0s). Trusted step metadata showed Restore cached CAO Dashboard returned success immediately in 6/6 samples but did not prevent Find latest CAO Dashboard run + Mount latest CAO Dashboard artifact (median 9s combined) or Upload Pages artifact (31.5s median, about 50% of build job).
